introHtml: PL bistro mugs combine durable ceramic construction with a classic, comfortable shape that feels substantial in hand. These mugs are ideal for coffee shops, office breakrooms, or corporate gift sets where you want a premium look without the fragility of standard porcelain. Many PL mugs, like the 12 oz Concord Mug or 15 oz Basecamp® Zion Mug, offer generous surface area for full-color logo imprinting using screen printing or pad printing. Their thick walls keep beverages hot longer, making them a practical choice for branded drinkware that gets daily use.
